sloka: बालम् मे तनयम् ब्रह्मन् नैव दास्यामि पुत्रकम् ।अथ काल उपमौ युद्धे सुतौ सुन्दोपसुन्दयोः ॥१-२०-२५॥
transliteration: bālam me tanayam brahman naiva dāsyāmi putrakam ।atha kāla upamau yuddhe sutau sundopasundayoḥ ॥1-20-25॥

translations.english: Further the sons of Sunda and Upasunda by name Maricha and Subahu are causing obstacles to your sacrifice. They resemble the god of death, Yama. I shall never part with my son.
